summary: Enhance prompt guidance on terminal failure observations to encourage full implementation and thorough validation before task completion.

edits.hypothesis: Injecting explicit validation and full implementation reminders upon detecting errors or test failures prevents premature completion attempts.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: A prompt instruction alone wouldn't dynamically trigger on observed command errors as effectively as intercepting the error observation flow.
edits.trigger_condition: Whenever terminal output contains ERROR, AssertionError, or FAIL.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) helps steer extract-elf and similar parsing tasks toward implementation and verification rather than looping or premature completion; (preservative) preserves normal failure feedback loops; (transfer) generalizes to any task with failing tests or tool errors.
edits.regression_risk: Low; purely modifies observation text on error conditions.
edits.mechanism: Injecting explicit validation and full implementation reminders upon detecting errors or test failures prevents premature completion attempts.

mechanism: Enhance prompt guidance on terminal failure observations to encourage full implementation and thorough validation before task completion.
